name: Community Health Toolkit Core
humanitarian_domain: Community health worker digital health systems

impact_evidence.claim: Medic reported CHT growth from about 40,000 to more than 180,000 community health workers across 24 countries by the end of 2025.
The CHT documentation presents the project as a Digital Public Good and includes current contributor documentation, AI guidance, releases, and security disclosure routes.

On 2026-09-08, the Digital Public Goods Alliance registry listed CHT as Verified, identified medic/cht-core as the evaluated repository, and showed a 2024-11-04 review date. The registry labels scale and SDG relevance as self-reported; verification is not a causal health-outcome evaluation.

A 2023 randomized trial of a CHT-based two-way texting workflow in South Africa enrolled 1,084 adult male circumcision clients and reported mean follow-up visits of 0.22 versus 1.34 for routine care. This measures the studied workflow, not CHT alone or Humanifest's proposed admin fix. Medic-affiliated coauthors participated; Humanifest has not independently replicated the analysis.

maintenance.current_public_activity: GitHub repository metadata and issue activity inspected 2026-09-06; open bugs updated as recently as 2026-09-05.
maintenance.current_risk: Large multi-package JavaScript/TypeScript application with Docker/Kubernetes paths; environment setup may be heavier than the initial Humanifest core.

contribution.pathway: GitHub issues, contributor guide, forum, and Good First Issue labels.
contribution.ai_policy: Reviewed 2026-09-08: disclose tool and use in the PR; retain human understanding, review, and testing responsibility. Current translation guidance requires fluent-speaker validation of non-fluent drafts.
